Method of Attack: Ransomware operation that infiltrates a network, steals unencrypted files, encrypts all data, and demands ransom to prevent publishing stolen data
Attack Vector: Phishing scam leading to stolen network credentials used to access Citrix server
Indicators of Compromise: Data leak site operated by SunCrypt
Bitcoin payment of 61.9 bitcoins on September 19th to ransomware bitcoin address
Stolen data including ID scans, DOB, SSN, illness type
